section.first:
Fails only applies to Balanced, Ceaseless, Relentless, and the combined rerolls. Those abilities only target fails, never norms or crits:
Rerolling a fail can only improve (to norm/crit) or stay the same
Rerolling a norm could get worse (to fail)
Rerolling a crit could only get worse (to norm/fail)
CritFishRelentless on the Shoot dropdowns rerolls non-crits the same way it does in a fight. The Fight calculator Notes say Balanced and Relentless will not reroll a normal success even if it would be wise to do so. See that note on the Fight calculator.
section.second:

Fight: the Fight calculator Notes cover Balanced and Relentless (see the section above)
